# `aitbc blockchain status`

Check the status and optional details or metrics of a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Specific chain ID to check status (shows all if not specified) |
| `--node-url` | text (multiple) | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL of a node to query (repeatable); falls back to the configured blockchain_rpc_url when no nodes are known |
| `--detailed` | flag | `false` | no | Show detailed status information |
| `--local` | flag | `false` | no | Query this node's own rpc (127.0.0.1:8202) instead of the configured blockchain_rpc_url |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain status
```
